UserPresence.title: UserPresence
UserPresence.description: Real-time online presence and last active status for a Coolerup account (without any PII or location).

uid.description: Authenticated user ID that owns this presence document.

handle.description: Normalized lowercase Coolerup handle for the account.

isOnline.description: Whether the user is currently active inside Coolerup.

lastActive.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent activity or disconnect.

showOnline.description: Privacy flag ('Show when I'm online'). When false, status is hidden from others.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the presence document was first created.

WatchHistoryEntry.title: WatchHistoryEntry
WatchHistoryEntry.description: Video watched by an authenticated Coolerup user for more than 3 seconds, tied to their account.

uid.description: Authenticated user ID that owns this watch history record.

source.description: Tab/platform source where the video was watched.

videoUrl.description: Playable video source URL or storage reference.

sourceUrl.description: Original external or embed URL when applicable.

watchRouteId.description: Full-video watch route ID (/watch/:id) when available.

youtubeId.description: YouTube video ID when source is youtube.

watchedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent watch.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this entry was first created.

WatchHistorySettings.title: WatchHistorySettings
WatchHistorySettings.description: Per-account preference controlling whether new watched videos are saved.

uid.description: Authenticated user ID that owns this setting.

saveWatchHistory.description: Whether Watch History recording is ON or OFF for the account.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the setting was last updated.

/user_presence/{presenceId}.description: Stores live online/offline presence (isOnline, lastActive, showOnline) keyed by deterministic handle ID.

/watch_history/{historyDocId}.description: Account-scoped watch history items ordered newest first in the client.

/watch_history_settings/{userId}.description: Account-scoped Save Watch History ON/OFF toggle.
